items.stem:
Diya has five minutes to present her start-up, which supplies fresh vegetables directly from farmers to restaurants in Surat, to a group of angel investors.
(i) Suggest five slides she should include, with one line on each.
items.answer: (i) Problem: restaurants pay high prices for stale vegetables; solution: direct farm-to-restaurant supply; market size: number of restaurants in the city; business model: margin per kg / subscription; financials and the ask: projections and amount sought (also team, competition).
items.markingKey: 5 marks: (i) Problem: restaurants pay high prices for stale vegetables; solution: direct farm-to-restaurant supply; market size: number of restaurants in the city; business model: margin per kg / subscription; financials and the ask: projections and amount sought (also team, competition).

items.stem: The amount of loan Saxena Traders needs and how it will be repaid. Which part of the business plan contains this information? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Financial plan. It covers funds and their sources.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Financial plan; 2 marks for the justification: It covers funds and their sources.

items.stem: Explain "Flexibility of a partnership" with reference to the features of a limited liability partnership.
items.answer: Flexibility of a partnership: Partners can organise their internal working by agreement.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for the point and 1 mark for the explanation: Partners can organise their internal working by agreement.

items.stem: Sethi and Sons keeps enough cloth for 15 days of production but not more. Which part of the operational plan is involved? Justify your answer.
items.answer: Inventory planning. It decides the stock of raw material.
items.markingKey: 1 mark for identifying Inventory planning; 2 marks for the justification: It decides the stock of raw material.

items.stem: Explain "Problem" with reference to the elements of a good pitch deck.
items.answer: Problem: The customer problem the business solves.
